solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Match box leads to legal action?

parts.note: a match, as in cricket, is a test
a box is a case or container

explanation.surface: A boxing match or a matchbox somehow ends up in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Match box' reads as the little container for matches, but it is two separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A test case is a lawsuit whose ruling sets a precedent for similar disputes.

clue.text: Part of head building, religious

definitions.meaning: the flat region at the side of the skull beside the eye
a house of worship, as for Hindus or Jews

explanation.surface: A section of a head on a religious building.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the side of the forehead and a place of worship.

clue.text: Some result — a new ruler!

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An outcome brings a fresh ruler to power.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultan is a Muslim sovereign, so a monarch or ruler.

clue.text: Be willing to assist barrel maker, worried

parts.note: a cooper is a craftsman who makes barrels
ate, as in what's eating you, means worried

explanation.surface: A worried cooper is ready to help.
explanation.definitionFit: To cooperate is to work together willingly, helping others toward a shared end.

clue.text: Throw water into crash site? Silly

parts.note: to scatter is to throw about

indicators.note: into means the water word goes inside the next piece

parts.note: a bed is where one crashes, slang for falling asleep
rain is water from the sky

explanation.surface: Someone flings water into the scene of a crash, foolishly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crash site' suggests an accident, but crash here is slang for going to sleep, so the site is a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone silly and disorganised is called scatterbrained, a near synonym.

clue.text: Have ambitions to depict a church feature?

parts.note: a spire is the tapering tower on top of a church

explanation.surface: An artist hopes to paint something on a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To have ambitions is to set one's hopes high, a direct synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Look fixedly at celebrity, rude in end

parts.note: a star is a celebrity

indicators.note: in end points to the final letter of the word rude

explanation.surface: Gazing at a famous person is rude in the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To stare is to gaze fixedly at someone, a direct synonym.

clue.text: At home this person's in charge leading to endless talk, hostile

parts.note: in means at home
this person is the speaker, I, and 's is short for is, giving I'M

indicators.note: endless means the word talk loses both its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A host in charge at home who talks endlessly turns hostile.
explanation.definitionFit: Inimical describes something unfriendly or harmful, a formal synonym.

clue.text: Create difficulties for early invader, not half potent initially

indicators.note: initially means the trimmed piece is placed at the start
not half means one half of the word potent is dropped

parts.note: the Angles were Germanic invaders of early Britain

explanation.surface: A powerful early invader who caused trouble, though only half as strong at first.
explanation.definitionFit: To entangle someone is to involve them in complications and difficulties.

clue.text: Exotic area, this with lake, extremely rivered? Quite the opposite

definitions.text: Exotic area, this with lake, extremely rivered? Quite the opposite

indicators.note: exotic means strange or foreign, so the letters given are rearranged
extremely points to the two end letters of the word rivered

explanation.surface: An exotic area with a lake and full of rivers, or rather the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: AREA, THIS, LAKE and R and D (the outside of 'rivered') are shuffled. The whole clue defines it: an exotic area, far from well-watered.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kalahari is a vast dry region in southern Africa, the opposite of a well-watered land.

clue.text: At front member, long-standing, eggs on Republic

indicators.note: at the front of the word member we find its opening letter

parts.note: something long-standing is old
ova are eggs, the plural of ovum

explanation.surface: A veteran politician urges on a republic from the front.
explanation.definitionFit: Moldova is a landlocked eastern European republic between Romania and Ukraine.

clue.text: Scholar's skill passes over unfortunate bias

indicators.note: the skill word stretches over the scrambled letters, enclosing them

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of conversation

indicators.note: unfortunate suggests the word bias has gone wrong and is jumbled

explanation.surface: An academic's talent overlooks an unhappy prejudice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'passes over' reads as ignoring, but here it means stretching over, enclosing; 'unfortunate' gives ABIS.
explanation.definitionFit: An Arabist is a specialist scholar of Arabic language and culture.

clue.text: Contract to give satisfaction? Not at first

indicators.note: not at first tells us to drop the opening letter of the word for satisfying

parts.note: to please someone is to give them satisfaction

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether a contract is meant to satisfy, and decides it isn't at first.
explanation.definitionFit: A lease is a contract letting property for a fixed term.

clue.text: Actor, tense, became very angry with Scotsman?

parts.note: T is the grammar abbreviation for tense
raged means became very angry
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A tense actor flew into a rage at a Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: A tragedian is an actor who specialises in tragic roles.

clue.text: Rash lad upset with in-law's old- fashioned obstruction?

indicators.note: upset means the letters of the rash lad and in-law are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: An impetuous boy is annoyed by his relative's outdated way of blocking him.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of in-law's is a link word, not fodder. Hadrian's Wall is the Roman barrier across northern England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman emperor Hadrian built this wall as a frontier barrier, so it is an ancient obstruction.

clue.text: Less elaborate small boat? That is right

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat
i.e. abbreviates id est, that is

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a little boat is less fancy, and is told it is.
explanation.definitionFit: Sketchier means rougher and more like a quick outline, so less detailed.

clue.text: Suspect the cops wanted initially found in Welsh town

indicators.note: suspect as an adjective means dubious, so the letters of the cops are shuffled
initially picks the opening letter of the word wanted

explanation.surface: A shady police officer wanted for questioning turns up in Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: Chepstow is a town in Monmouthshire on the Welsh border, known for its racecourse.

clue.text: Name on ship for capital guy?

parts.note: to dub is to name
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A name painted on a vessel for a fine fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like 'excellent' but means from the capital of Ireland; in a down answer 'on' puts one piece above the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dubliner is a person from Dublin, the capital city of Ireland.

clue.text: Going outside?

parts.note: a pet that relieves itself outdoors rather than indoors has been taught toilet habits

explanation.definitionFit: A pet taught to do its business outdoors, not in the house, has been trained this way.

clue.text: Biter is able to take top off wine

parts.note: can means is able

indicators.note: take top off removes the first letter, the top in a down answer, from the word wine

explanation.surface: A dog bites after being allowed to uncork the wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A canine is a pointed tooth used for biting, so a biter.

clue.text: Church employee, male, say, not going morth

parts.note: male is an example of a sex, the say marking it as an example

indicators.note: going north means travelling upward, so in a down answer the word not is read bottom to top

explanation.surface: A male church worker who refuses to head north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'morth' is a misprint for north: 'going north' turns NOT into TON.
explanation.definitionFit: A sexton is a church officer who looks after the building and churchyard.

clue.text: Penalties for misbehaving in biblical location?

indicators.note: misbehaving letters are out of order, so the word penalties is rearranged

explanation.surface: Punishments for bad behaviour in a place from the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Palestine is the region where much of the Bible's narrative takes place.

clue.text: Quiet pioneer disregarding odds to perform well

parts.note: sh is the instruction to be quiet

indicators.note: disregarding odds means ignoring the odd-numbered letters of pioneer and keeping the even ones

explanation.surface: A modest pioneer who ignores the odds succeeds.
explanation.definitionFit: To shine is to excel or do brilliantly.

clue.text: Run after tea ultimately his exercise

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letters of both his and exercise

explanation.surface: After tea, his workout is a run.
explanation.definitionFit: To run after someone is to pursue them, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Annuity scheme — sound money taken in

indicators.note: taken in means one word is absorbed into the middle of the other

parts.note: a tone is a sound
tin is old slang for money

explanation.surface: An annuity plan is a sound investment for taking in money.
explanation.definitionFit: A tontine is an investment scheme whose annuities pass to surviving members until the last one takes all.

clue.text: Snob perhaps is impressed by fancy title

indicators.note: impressed by means pressed into, so is goes inside the scrambled letters
fancy as an adjective suggests something elaborate, signalling the word title is reworked

explanation.surface: A snob is impressed by someone with a grand title.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' gives ELITT; 'impressed by' reads as admiring but means pressed into. 'perhaps' marks a snob as just one example.
explanation.definitionFit: A snob may be someone who believes in the superiority of a select few, an example of the type.

clue.text: Park official in conflict with animal home

parts.note: war is armed conflict
a den is the lair of a wild animal

explanation.surface: A park keeper argues with the owner of an animal shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A park warden is the official who supervises and looks after a park.

clue.text: Doctor eating first helping of tuna fish

indicators.note: eating means taking something in, so the doctor word swallows a letter

parts.note: a surgeon is a kind of doctor

indicators.note: the first helping of tuna is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A doctor tucks into a first serving of tuna.
explanation.definitionFit: The sturgeon is a large fish prized for its roe, caviar.
